days.title: Arrival, Vintage Tea & Local Chocolate Trails
days.summary: Board the KSRTC bus from Bangalore to Ooty. Check-in at the beautiful Welbeck Vintage, relax on the lawns or veranda with warm tea, and explore local chocolate trails and cozy dining in the evening.
checklist: Pack warm jackets and a sturdy umbrella/raincoat at the top of your bag
Keep ample physical cash handy for local autos (UPI can fail in pockets of rain/fog)

timeline.title: Cab/Auto from Home
timeline.description: Head out early to beat the Bangalore morning traffic towards the Kengeri boarding point.

timeline.title: Onward Bus Departure
timeline.description: Board the KSRTC Airavat club class bus from Kengeri TTMC. Enjoy the scenic drive through Bandipur.

timeline.title: Arrival & Monsoon-Paced Auto Ride
timeline.description: Arrive at Ooty Bus Stand (accounting for a realistic 30-min monsoon/ghat delay). Take a quick local auto up to the hotel.

timeline.title: Late Hotel Check-In & Lunch
timeline.description: Check into Welbeck Vintage and settle down for a quick, comforting lunch at the resort's restaurant.

timeline.title: Evening Tea (Veranda / Lawns)
timeline.description: Enjoy hot tea and local snacks. Shift to the resort's covered veranda if the evening monsoon mist sets in early.

timeline.title: Explore Charing Cross & Chocolates
timeline.description: Take an auto down to Charing Cross. Sample and stock up on fresh handmade truffles at King Star Confectionery.

timeline.title: Auto to Dinner Cafe
timeline.description: Take a short 5-minute auto ride from Charing Cross to avoid the evening chill and rain.
timeline.location: Charing Cross to Place To Bee

timeline.title: Cozy Dinner at Place To Bee
timeline.description: Have an intimate, low-key dinner at Place To Bee café, enjoying their excellent vegetarian wood-fired pizzas.

timeline.title: Auto Return to Hotel
timeline.description: Hire a local auto outside the restaurant to head back to the resort through the crisp, chilly night air.
timeline.location: Place To Bee to Welbeck Vintage

days.title: Misty Biosphere, Private Jeep Safari & Lake Strolls
days.summary: Hire a dedicated local cab for a scenic drive southwest. Experience a private, exclusive Forest Department jeep safari through the untouched Shola forests to Avalanche Lake, enjoy a pure-veg wood-fired lunch, and spend a relaxing afternoon walking the terraced lawns of the Botanical Gardens followed by quiet boating.
checklist: Carry at least ₹3,500 in hard cash specifically for the forest safari (UPI/network drops to zero in the valley)
Wear comfortable sneakers with good grip for walking on wet, terraced garden paths
Pack a warm fleece or windbreaker layer as the open-air jeep ride gets incredibly chilly

timeline.title: Relaxed Resort Breakfast
timeline.description: Wake up to the crisp mountain air and enjoy a fresh, hot vegetarian breakfast spread at the resort to fuel up for the bumpy journey ahead.

timeline.title: Scenic Southwest Drive
timeline.description: Your hired day-cab picks you up from the resort lobby. Begin the scenic drive winding past lush tea estates and mist-covered valley curves.

timeline.title: Emerald Lake Photo Stop
timeline.description: Have your driver pull over at the viewpoint. Catch the morning mist clearing over the brilliant blue water and green slopes for some beautiful pictures together.

timeline.title: Drive to Avalanche Forest Checkpost
timeline.description: Continue the final stretch of the road through the protected hills to the Forest Department Eco-Tourism center.

timeline.title: Exclusive Private Jeep Safari
timeline.description: Secure an official flat-rate ticket using hard cash. Track a rugged 6 km dirt trail through the protected Nilgiri Biosphere in an open-air forest jeep, stopping right at the pristine edges of Avalanche Lake, deep-woods waterfalls, and quiet pine paths.

timeline.title: Return Journey to Ooty Town
timeline.description: Hop back into your day-cab and head back up out of the valley toward the Ooty town center.

timeline.title: Pure-Veg Wood-Fired Lunch
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting, completely vegetarian lunch at Nahar's Sidewalk Café. Try their signature wood-fired pizzas cooked with locally crafted Nilgiri cheeses in a lovely old-world ambiance.

timeline.title: Terraced Stroll at Botanical Garden
timeline.description: Explore the magnificent, terraced Government Botanical Garden. Doing this early in the afternoon gives you the best chance of clear skies before late afternoon monsoon showers hit.

timeline.title: Private Boating on Ooty Lake
timeline.description: Have your cab drop you at the Ooty Boat House. Rent a private 2-seater pedal boat and spend a peaceful, uninterrupted half-hour drifting on the water beneath giant eucalyptus trees (keep cash handy for a refundable security deposit).

timeline.title: Drop Back to Resort & Unwind
timeline.description: Your cab drops you back off at Welbeck Vintage, completing its full-day booking. Head inside to escape the sharp evening chill, unpack your local truffles, and enjoy a warm dinner at the resort.

timeline.title: Relaxed Resort Breakfast
timeline.description: Enjoy a fresh, hot vegetarian breakfast spread at Welbeck Vintage while your driver confirms the checkpost operational status.

timeline.title: Scenic Southwest Valley Drive
timeline.description: Head southwest past terraced tea plantations. Enjoy the dramatic morning mist moving over the mountain curves.

timeline.title: Emerald Lake Viewpoint Stop
timeline.description: Brief roadside photo pause to witness the morning fog hanging low over the vast, brilliant blue reservoir.

timeline.title: Drive to Avalanche Checkpost
timeline.description: Drive the final stretch down into the valley, arriving to find the inner forest safari gates closed due to weather.

timeline.title: Extended Emerald Lake Lakeside Walk
timeline.description: Since the safari is closed, turn back and make the most of the valley. Stop at a safe, accessible bank of Emerald Lake for a peaceful, slow walk along the misty shoreline.

timeline.title: Return Commute to Town Grid
timeline.description: Drive back up out of the lake basin toward the central Ooty town grid for lunch.

timeline.title: Pure-Veg Wood-Fired Lunch
timeline.description: Warm up from the chilly valley breeze with hot wood-fired pizzas and pasta at Nahar's Sidewalk Café.

timeline.title: Private Boating on Ooty Lake
timeline.description: Head right down to the city-edge Ooty Boat House. Rent a 2-seater pedal boat for a quick, scenic glide under towering eucalyptus trees before the afternoon showers hit.

timeline.title: Cinematic Stroll at Pine Forest
timeline.description: Take a short drive northwest to the Pine Forest. Walk through the soaring trees on paths coated in pine needles—the forest provides wonderful cover from light monsoonal drizzle.

timeline.title: Indoor Escape: Ooty Tea Factory
timeline.description: As the heavy evening fog rolls in, head completely indoors. Tour the factory floors to see how Nilgiri tea is processed, sample hot cardamom tea, and browse the Chocolate Museum.

timeline.title: Drop Back to Resort & Unwind
timeline.description: Your cab drops you back at Welbeck Vintage. Escape the evening drop in temperature, review your day's photos, and relax over a hot dinner.

days.title: Heritage Toy Train & Coonoor Highlands
days.summary: Take the legendary Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train down to Coonoor. Savor a peaceful, walk-in vegetarian lunch, explore the dramatic, fog-laden valley drops of Lamb's Rock and Dolphin's Nose via a cozy local cab, and return to Ooty for a spectacular pavilion dinner at Earl's Secret.
checklist: Arrive at Ooty Station by 10:30 AM to secure your coach spots and take photos with the steam engine
Keep physical printouts or official SMS of your IRCTC toy train tickets handy
Pack your thickest winter layers for the evening—Ooty drops in temperature sharply after sunset

timeline.title: Easy Morning Breakfast
timeline.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast spread at Welbeck Vintage. There is no need to rush since your train departs mid-morning.

timeline.title: Auto to Ooty Railway Station
timeline.description: Take a short local auto ride down the hill straight to the heritage railway station.

timeline.title: Arrive at Vintage Ooty Railway Station
timeline.description: Reach the station early. The heritage building feels like a step back in time—perfect for taking photos with the historic blue steam engine before boarding.

timeline.title: Heritage Toy Train Journey (NMR)
timeline.description: Board the iconic Nilgiri Mountain Railway train down to Coonoor. The 95-minute ride slowly winds past emerald tea estates, dark tunnels, and over old stone viaducts.

timeline.title: Arrival at Coonoor & Quick Commute
timeline.description: De-board at Coonoor station and take a very brief auto ride up to the Bedford area for lunch.

timeline.title: Peaceful Vegetarian Lunch
timeline.description: Walk into Sri Lakshmi Cafe in Bedford for a simple, comforting, and authentic South Indian vegetarian thali or crispy ghee roasts in a hassle-free setting.

timeline.title: Hired Cab Circuit to Lamb's Rock & Dolphin's Nose
timeline.description: Hire a warm, closed local road-cab right outside the cafe for a dedicated ridge-line trip. Drive through deep green tea estates to Lamb's Rock, then continue to Dolphin's Nose to witness the massive 180-degree ravines swirling with monsoon mist.

timeline.title: Scenic Road Journey Back to Ooty
timeline.description: Head back up to Ooty via a point-to-point local road cab. Traveling up the ghats by road is much quicker and lets you see the tea country under the evening fog.

timeline.title: Rest, Refresh & Layer Up at Resort
timeline.description: Return to Welbeck Vintage to drop off your bags, refresh yourself, and change into thick winter layers as the evening temperature drops sharply.

timeline.title: Auto to Earl's Secret
timeline.description: Take a short auto ride through the misty evening over to the King's Cliff heritage hotel property.

timeline.title: Cozy Pavilion Dinner at Earl's Secret
timeline.description: Indulge in a beautiful dinner inside a heated glass pavilion at Earl's Secret. Enjoy their excellent multi-cuisine vegetarian menu surrounded by old-world mountain charm.

timeline.title: Auto Return to Resort
timeline.description: Grab a local auto outside the property for a quick ride back to your room to wrap up the day.

days.title: Doddabetta Panorama or Cozy Town Retreat & Departure
days.summary: Spend the final morning catching panoramic views from Doddabetta Peak, or pivot to a cozy indoor morning shopping for local spices and resting. Enjoy a stress-free checkout and a reliable, hot pure-veg lunch right next to the bus station before boarding your afternoon bus back to Bangalore.
checklist: Check the mountain peaks from the resort at 07:30 AM to decide between the Main and Backup timelines
Keep a light jacket easily accessible at the top of your baggage for the windy summit or the air-conditioned KSRTC bus ride
Pack local chocolates, tea powders, and spices securely in plastic layers to protect them from monsoon moisture

timeline.title: Early Resort Breakfast
timeline.description: Enjoy an early, warm vegetarian breakfast at Welbeck Vintage. Moving this up gives you the best shot at beating the heavy mountain fog.

timeline.title: Morning Drive to Doddabetta Peak
timeline.description: Hop into a local cab or auto for a crisp, scenic 25-minute drive up the winding mountain slopes before the clouds completely swallow the ridge.

timeline.title: Sweeping Views from the Summit
timeline.description: Take a short, easy walk from the parking lot. Explore the telescope house observatory and enjoy magnificent 360-degree panoramic views over the valley while the morning air is still sharp and clear.

timeline.title: Return Commute to Resort
timeline.description: Head back down the mountain road in your ride, watching the heavy white fog slowly roll across the lower tea fields.

timeline.title: Pack Bags & Smooth Checkout
timeline.description: You have a massive, stress-free 2.5-hour window to freshen up, change into comfortable clothes for the long bus ride, pack your chocolate boxes securely, and check out by 01:00 PM.

timeline.title: Strategic Lunch Near Bus Stand
timeline.description: Take an auto straight down to the main town grid right next to the bus station. Walk into Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) or Hotel Saravana Bhavan for a quick, piping-hot, and reliable pure-vegetarian lunch, completely eliminating transit anxiety.

timeline.title: Auto from Lunch to Bus Platforms
timeline.description: A nominal 2-minute auto hop across the street to the bus stand gates with your luggage.

timeline.title: Relaxed Boarding at Ooty Bus Stand
timeline.description: Arrive comfortably early. Pick up water bottles or snacks for the road, locate your platform, and settle into your KSRTC Airavat seats well ahead of the 03:35 PM departure.

timeline.title: Return Bus Journey to Bangalore
timeline.description: Board the KSRTC Airavat Club Class bus heading back home, descending the scenic ghats.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri Metro Station
timeline.description: Arrive safely back at Kengeri Metro Station, Bangalore, bypassing the central city traffic.

timeline.title: Cab/Auto Back Home
timeline.description: Take a quick final cab or auto ride back home to conclude your trip.

timeline.title: Slow-Paced Lazy Breakfast
timeline.description: Sleep in to escape the damp morning cold. Enjoy a very relaxed, late vegetarian breakfast spread at the resort without any rush.

timeline.title: Pack Bags & Mid-Morning Rest
timeline.description: Freshen up, pack your bags calmly, and relax inside the cozy indoor resort ambiance while listening to the monsoon rain outside.

timeline.title: Indoor Spice Shopping & Local Market
timeline.description: Check out of the hotel and take a covered auto down to the local commercial shops. Spend a quiet hour picking up aromatic Nilgiri oils, fresh cardamom, and spices completely protected from the rain.

timeline.title: Strategic Lunch Near Bus Stand
timeline.description: Head right down next to the bus station platform. Enjoy a hot, comforting pure-vegetarian South Indian thali or ghee roasts at A2B or Saravana Bhavan.

timeline.title: Early Boarding at Ooty Bus Stand
timeline.description: Walk comfortably across the street into the covered shelter of the bus stand platforms. Grab some hot tea, find your KSRTC bus, and settle in early to stay warm.

timeline.title: Return Bus Journey to Bangalore
timeline.description: Board the KSRTC Airavat Club Class bus heading back home, descending the scenic ghats.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri Metro Station
timeline.description: Arrive safely back at Kengeri Metro Station, Bangalore, bypassing the central city traffic.

timeline.title: Cab/Auto Back Home
timeline.description: Take a quick final cab or auto ride back home to conclude your trip.
